title: Law to bar officials from insider trading on prediction markets
summary: This bill would ban the mayor, comptroller, public advocate, Council members, borough presidents and other high-ranking city officials, along with their close relatives, from trading prediction market contracts using non-public information they gain through their jobs. Officials would have to annually disclose any prediction market transaction of $50 or more, including its amount, date, subject and any profit or loss. Violations could bring a civil penalty of up to $25,000, repayment of any gains, and possible loss of public office, and the law would take effect 180 days after enactment.
